answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade: one identity, one bond, slashed on proven fraud. A sybil farm then pays the full stake per fake identity instead of spawning free copies, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. Honest agents earn the stake back plus fees, while the ledger stays crystal clear about who risked what — no oasis of free identities for attackers to hide in.
